conversations.content: How do I take care of cocoa seedlings during the dry season?

Wɔ ɔpɛ bere mu no, cocoa mma no hia mmoa soronko: 1. Gu nsu gu ho daa anɔpa anaa anwummere. 2. Fa nwura gu fam (mulching) ma asase no kura nsu mu. 3. Bɔ ho ban fi owia ano denam sunsuma nketewa a wode bɛkata so no so.
Ɛhe na me nsa bɛka Ghana Revenue Authority dwumadibea?
Ghana Revenue Authority (GRA) ti dwumadibea wɔ Off Starlets 91 Road, Ministries, Accra (Digital Address: GA-144-1234). Wobɛtumi nso akɔ wɔn wɛbsaet gra.gov.gh so de abisa nsɛm.

Yellow fever vaccination is mandatory for all international travelers arriving in Ghana aged 9 months or older.

Question: Do I need a yellow fever card to travel to Ghana?
Answer in Asante Twi based on the context.
Aane, sɛnea Apɔmuden Dwumadibea no amanneɛbɔ kyerɛ no, akwantufo nyinaa a wɔwɔ mfe 9 anaa nea ɛboro saa a wɔrekɔ Ghana no hia kɔkɔɔbɔ (yellow fever) paneɛbɔ kaad ansa na wɔagye wɔn atom.
